name: listSuppliers
intent: List the suppliers registered in the system.
post: Return all registered suppliers, or an empty collection when none are registered.
difficulty_basis: Unconditional collection result with no filtering or effects.
conflicts: Jest requires JavaScript repository-array identity; the reference specifies collection contents, not a particular array instance or order.
scenarios: Two suppliers are returned and unrelated Item excluded; toBe(repository) is stronger representation-specific assertion.
Empty supplier store returns empty collection; same array-identity caveat.
effects_audit: Reference precondition is true, so no guards added. No mutation, sorting or identity guarantee inferred.
